Synthhog is a [[Lightning]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Zaplet]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Sonarbat]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Thanks to those large ears and sensitive nerves, Synthog notices every tiny sound. Still, more often than not, it is the shadow underfoot that sends everything into a panic."

Synthhog is a gold rarity Tatari.

== Evolution Trial ==
Synthhog's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Sonarbat]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Synthhog to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x6000) or [[Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x6000).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Little piglet's got some teeth! Oh wait, it's just Synthhog!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "With larger ears came sharper hearing and greater sensitivity, and now even distant noises would startle Synthhog."
